input.format: JSON array of objects with an at field containing an ISO 8601 timestamp with an explicit timezone

paths.relative_paths: relative to the current working directory

report.window_bounds: fixed-length half-open intervals of window_minutes minutes from the origin
report.rows: one line per nonempty window, ordered by start time, containing the UTC window start and event count
report.overwrite_false: fail if output exists and preserve the existing file
report.overwrite_true: replace existing output without retaining a previous version or providing undo
report.later_changes: changing the source file or configuration does not update an existing report

cli.instance_lifetime: create a fresh ReportSession for every render command; do not reuse a session across commands
cli.exit: exit code 0 after a successful write; nonzero on invalid input, missing output directory, or refused overwrite

sdk.constructor: ReportSession() starts with no loaded events, window_minutes=30, and no prepared windows
sdk.load_events(path): replace the loaded events and invalidate prepared windows; later source-file changes are not read until load_events is called again
sdk.set_window_minutes(value): accept a positive integer; changing the value invalidates prepared windows; may be called before or after load_events
sdk.prepare_windows(): requires events to have been loaded; compute windows from the current loaded events and current window_minutes, then mark them prepared
sdk.write_report(path, overwrite=false): requires prepared windows; otherwise raise WindowsNotPrepared and write nothing; use the same output and overwrite rules as the CLI
sdk.reuse: multiple writes may reuse prepared windows while loaded events and window_minutes remain unchanged
